latestTerminalSummary:
I scored all 14 categories 10 in round 36, and I found nothing left to fix in the tag-editing UI I inspected. This is one reviewer's opinion and counts toward the first of the two consecutive joint rounds needed; Sol's round-36 scores are still needed.

The report is at `docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-36-opus-tags-ten.md`.

- **Build checked:** I reviewed the frozen build `f58de10b` with assets `4beedb277545`. The scoped diff and porcelain were empty at entry and at cleanup, and the running server binaries' hashes matched the build record both times. I ran no builds or tests.
- **Round-35 issue fixed:** my only deduction last round was the Add button overhanging the column. In the live sample it now ends exactly at the shared edge: x=554 at 1280px and x=294 at 320px, in both light and dark.
- **Run Log coverage:** I viewed all 16 core states (four widths × light/dark × Tags panel and Edit tag sheet). Where Create was clipped (390 and 320), I scrolled and viewed it fully, so every panel pair includes the lower controls through Create. Both colour-scheme media queries were checked at every pair.
- **Sample coverage:** on the sample instance (my own incognito tab), I viewed 1280 and 320 in both schemes. Each pair covered the wrapped long tag name, selecting Utilities to enable Add and resetting it without pressing Add, and the lower controls through Create.
- **Local checks, all restored or cancelled:**
  - A Red colour change in the sheet enabled Save tag; I cancelled it.
  - An incomplete `#37` hex in the create form showed the error in place of the hint and kept Create disabled.
  - Delete tag… → Keep tag returned to the sheet with the name intact. I never pressed the final Delete, never pressed Enter in a field, and saved nothing.
- **Not covered:** real save, create, add, remove or delete outcomes, the native colour dialog, Safari, physical phones and screen readers.
- **Cleanup:** Run Log's tags and colours are unchanged, and neither tab made any tag API requests. Both tabs are back to the system appearance, and I closed only my own two tabs.
